name: Staircase
concept: One monumental white stair: the show is an entrance, a descent, a seat and an exit.
object: A 10 m wide stair rising 5 m to a doorway upstage, every riser an LED strip
photoMoment: The artist in silhouette in the doorway at the top of the stair, every riser lit white below her.

elements.note: 20 risers of 25 cm, 40 cm treads; LED strip in each riser; treads take projection.
Doorway at the top with a white backlight behind.

acts.name: Entrance
acts.state: Artist appears in the doorway, backlit, and holds.
acts.light: Single white backlight through haze, stair dark.

acts.name: Descent
acts.state: Artist walks down; risers light one step per beat beneath her.

acts.name: Seated
acts.state: Artist sits on the stair; treads show slow projected texture.
acts.light: One follow spot, everything else off.

acts.name: Exit
acts.state: Artist climbs back up into the white door; confetti over the house.

buildNotes: Stair is a static set piece (no kinetics), so it is the cheapest design to build first. Rail-free stair: keep choreography slow on it.
